description: Use when a question needs a custom query over the AgenticGeoMate geoscience database. Runs one read-only SELECT (or WITH/EXPLAIN) and returns the rows. Read-only is enforced by the database connection, not only checked: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL cannot run. Tables can be joined across schemas (anumber links most tables to a WAMEX report; geom supports spatial joins via ST_DWithin). Rows are capped (default 1000, max 5000) and the query times out at 30s -- aggregate or add LIMIT for big tables. Results are paged: when page.next is set there are more rows -- call again with the same sql and page.next's limit and offset. A page is also cut to ~800k characters (wide rows): then truncated is true and page.next continues from the first row not returned. Account, token and chat tables are not readable. Read-only SQL against AgenticGeoMate's own PostgreSQL/PostGIS database (30-second timeout, up to 5,000 rows a page), documented at https://geo.nlp-tlp.org/docs#sql; sql_tables lists the tables and sql_describe a table's columns.

offset.description: Rows to skip: page.next.offset of the previous call (default 0).

sql.description: A single SELECT statement, no trailing ';'.

name: sql_query
title: Run a read-only SQL query
